subject: GCP co-sell: Aurelius Health listing readiness & joint pipeline review
messages:
From: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@google.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: GCP co-sell: Aurelius Health listing readiness & joint pipeline review

Hi Vanessa and team,

Thanks for taking this on. Aurelius Health (Priya and Michael on cc) have been progressing quickly — they want to list an integration in the GCP Marketplace and run a co-sell motion with Google field. Before we lock in a listing date, Rajesh from the GCP partner team asked for a short joint pipeline review and a quick readiness checklist review.

High-level asks from GCP: 
- Confirm listing artifacts (SAAS vs VM listing details)
- Mutual action plan with milestones to co-sell with field
- Top 5 prioritized accounts for joint outreach and current qualification status

Can we schedule a 30-min sync this week? Rajesh suggested Wed 10/7 10-10:30 PT or Thu 10/8 2-2:30 PT. If those don't work, propose alternatives. I attached the initial Aurelius product brief for context.

Thanks,
Rajesh
Partner Manager, Google Cloud

Attachment: aurelius-integration-brief.pdf (PDF, 420KB)

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@google.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@aureliushealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: Aurelius Health listing readiness & joint pipeline review

Rajesh — appreciate the context and the brief. Either Wed 10/7 10 PT or Thu 10/8 2 PT works for us; leaning toward Thu to give Karthik and Laura a bit more prep time.

Proposed agenda (30 min):
1) Quick intros and goals for co-sell (5 min)
2) Verify listing artifacts and required GCP artifacts (5 min)
3) Joint pipeline: top accounts, qualification gaps, proposed outreach owners (12 min)
4) Next steps and timeline for listing + Mural of responsibilities (8 min)

Karthik / Laura / Marcus — can you pull the listing checklist and the current opportunity list for Aurelius before Thu? I uploaded an early playbook PDF and a listing checklist (see attachments) — I'll add a pre-read Drive link in a follow-up.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: aurelius-gcp-playbook-v1.pdf, gcp-listing-checklist.xlsx

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@google.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@aureliushealth.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: Aurelius Health listing readiness & joint pipeline review

Thanks Vanessa — prepping the opportunity list now. Early notes from our side: 
- Top priority accounts for joint outreach: BayHealth, Meridian Clinics, SolaceCare, and two pilot accounts (internal NDAed).
- Qualification summary: two accounts are POC-ready, one is still evaluating procurement (needs pricing/usage estimate), pilot accounts expect an internal security sign-off week of 10/12.
- Risk flags: Aurelius has a couple of org-level compliance docs pending (data residency clarification and SOC2 evidence). Laura, Marcus — can you surface the SOC-2 audit pack and a short note on the data residency options we plan to include in the listing? Rajesh — we should confirm whether GCP Marketplace requires the evidence to be uploaded prior to listing or if it can be provided during co-sell enablement.

I attached a draft mutual action plan that maps milestones to owners; please review and bring edits to the sync.

— Karthik
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual-action-plan-aurelius.docx

From: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@google.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@aureliushealth.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: Aurelius Health listing readiness & joint pipeline review

Confirmed for Thu 10/8 2:00-2:30 PT — invite sent (Google Meet). Quick clarifications ahead of the meeting: 
- GCP listing requirement: we prefer to have the SOC2 evidence available in advance for validation. If the customer cannot upload before listing, provide a targeted timeline in the MAP and a point-of-contact for the audit team.
- For co-sell enablement, the field will want a lead sheet per prioritized account (one-pager, commercial ask, expected ARR, key stakeholders). If you can prepare 3 lead sheets for the most prioritized accounts, that will accelerate field engagement.

I'll bring the regional field contacts for the Bay Area and Mountain West.

– Rajesh
Partner Manager, Google Cloud

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@google.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@aureliushealth.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, marcus_lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Oct 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP co-sell: Aurelius Health listing readiness & joint pipeline review

Great sync — notes and actions below for the thread so everyone (and the field) has a single source: 

Meeting recap (Thu 10/8):
- Action: Aurelius to upload SOC2 evidence or provide timeline (Priya) — target 10/15.
- Action: Redwood to produce 3 account lead sheets (Karthik) — draft by 10/12.
- Action: Redwood & Aurelius to finalize GCP listing artifacts and publish listing draft to internal Drive (Vanessa/Laura) — target 10/14.
- Action: Rajesh to intro regional field leads for Bay Area and Mountain West (Rajesh) — done (see intro thread).

Risk log (captured): data residency confirmation pending (engineering Q&A), procurement timelines for one large account uncertain (requires CFO engagement), listing metadata mapping (SKU, pricing model) needs sign-off.

Next steps: I uploaded the joint playbook PDF, the MAP doc, and the checklist to Drive and shared with the GCP field. Links attached below. If anyone needs edits to the MAP, add comments directly on the document; we'll lock the MAP 10/13 to meet the 10/15 SOC2 target.

Shared links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAureliusPlaybook
HubSpot opp: https://hubspot.com/contacts/opp/RW-2026-AURE-3847

Thanks everyone — good momentum.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments (uploaded): aurelius-gcp-playbook-v1.pdf, gcp-listing-checklist.xlsx, mutual-action-plan-aurelius.docx
